added.prompt: Extreme close-up of a single oversized sculptural earring worn on the ear. Made from translucent and opaque molded plastic, the earring features biomorphic forms inspired by deep-sea flora and microscopic marine structures rather than recognizable flowers. Inflated petals, flowing tentacle-like extensions, curling filaments, layered translucent membranes, and crystalline protrusions merge into a fluid organic composition. Palette: transparent cobalt, milky white, pale jade, and clear resin. High-gloss finish, futuristic Gen Z fashion, premium designer jewelry, macro beauty editorial, soft studio lighting, hyper-realistic skin texture.
